newsitem.title: THAILAND: MDX unit Laos power plant ready in 1998.
newsitem.headline: MDX unit Laos power plant ready in 1998.

text.p: MDX Power Co Ltd, a unit of MDX Plc, said on Wednesday that it would complete its $280 million hydropower plant in Laos by March 1998.

The plant located near the Nam Hinboum river, about 300 km east of the Laotian capital of Vientiane, is a joint venture project between MDX, state-enterprise Electricite de Laos and Norway's Nordic Hydro-power AB, MDX Power managing director Swarng Champa told Reuters in an interview.
MDX Power and Nordic each own 20 percent of the power venture and Electricite de Laos the remainder.

"We plan to sell 95 percent of the total electricity production to the state-run Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT), while the remaining five percent will be sold to Laos for its own consumption," Swarng said.

"MDX Power has signed a 25-year agreement for sales of electricity to EGAT starting from 1998, and it has received a 30-year concession agreement from the Loatian government to operate the plant," he added.
